content: Pablo, Jerusalénʼse nadegusad
Gwenadgangi anmar bangudgu, urgi anmar Cos-dupse nadegumalad. Banedgine, Rodas-dupse anmar obaksamalad, geb agi, Pátara-neggweburse anmar obaksamarbalid.
Geb anmar Pátaraʼgi ur Fenicia-yarse-nae-sognai dakdapid. Anmar a-urba nakwis nadsunnad.

Anmar nadapgu, Chipre-dupgi bakar anmar-ur nasad. Anmar nasmargu, anmar-argan-sapiledsik Chipre-dup-nai anmar egi nasmalad. Geb Siria-yarse anmarga ur nagudapid. Geb agine, Tiro-neggweburse anmarga nadbalid. Ar ade, ur-anmarga-nadapidi, ibmar-semaidi Tiroʼgi obegoye sognadapid.
Agi anmar gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad dakalid. A-walik anmar ibagugle (7) megialid. Gwenadgan Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba Pabloʼga sokarmalad: “Mer Jerusalénʼse be nae.”

Ibaguglegusad-sorba (7) anmar gannar ali gusmalad. Anmar argua, bela gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad na e-omeganmala, degi, e-mimmiganse-bakar, neggwebur-noedse anmar berbealid. Agi anmar demar-gaka-naba bela yokorgi sindigar-sii, Bab-Dummadse gochamarsunnad.
Agi, anmar degimaloye sogsamargu, na bela angaagwar na gasmargua, anmar urgi nakwisad. Emardi, gannar na e-negse nadmarsunnad.
Degi, anmar Tiroʼgi-nai urgi argua, Tolemaida-neggweburse an nonimalad. Agi Bab-Jesús-nuggi anmar gwenadganga doggus-nuedye sogsad. Ibagwen amar-walik anmar megismalad.

Oibosgu, anmar nagab Cesarea-neggweburse nadmalad. A-neggweburse anmar modapgu, Felipe-negse anmar dogdapid. A-dulede, Jesúsʼgi-abonolegedgi-sunmakedid, degi, dulemar-walagugle (7) Jerusalén-neggweburgi gwenadgan-bendakega-sulesmalad-wargwenadid. A-neggi, anmar wis obunnodapid.
Felipeʼde sisgan walabake nikad, amba yoo-sui-nikumalad. Amarde, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad gumarmogad.
Anmar ibbigbagus-megdaedgine, dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, Judea-yargi-mai nonikid. A-dulede, Agaboʼye nugad.

Agaboʼde anmarse ataknonikid. Geb Agaboʼde Pablo-e-molidub susa imaksad. Geb agi na dukin e-mali-edichad, e-argan na edichabalid. Deyob imaksagu, weyob sogded: “Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled soged: ‘Weyobi Jerusalénʼgi Judíoʼmar we-molidub-ibed-edinmaloed, degi, Judíoʼsurmaladga a-dule-ukmarbaloed.’ ”
Anmar Agabo-degi-soge-itosgu, anmar Cesarea-dorganmala, Pablo mer Jerusalénʼse-naega, egi wilenai gusmalad.

Pabloʼdi anmarga sokalid: “¿Ibiga be bomarsunna? Bukib-binsaega be an-imakarmalad. Bato an guagwar gudiid, ar an-edinmarye-sogele, akarsulid. Jerusalén-neggweburgi Jesucristo-nuggi-burgweye an sogele, an guakwagwad.”
Ar anmar geg Pablo-binsaed ogwagussoggu, anmar ega sogdesunnad: “Bab-Dummad-sogedba bega ibmar gusun.”
Geb a-ibagan-sorbali, anmar guagwar ibmar-sedmaloed amismalad. Geb Jerusalén-neggweburse anmar nadsunnad.

Anmarba Cesarea-akar gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, nadmarmogad. Gwenadgan-Cesareaʼginmaladba Chipreʼgined-wargwen, Mnasónʼye-nugadi danigusmogad. Anmar Jerusalénʼse modapgu, gwenadgan Mnasón-negse anmar-sesmalad, ar ade, a-neggi anmar megoye sogsad. Mnasónʼde gebe-Bab-Jesúsʼba-naigusad-duled.
Pablo, Santiagoʼse atakapid
Jerusalénʼse anmar mosgu, gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad bela weligwar anmar-abindaksamalad.
A-banedgine, anmar Pabloʼba Santiagoʼse atakapid. Agine, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-e-idumalad bela bukwa gusmalad.
Pablo amar-argan-gasad-sorbali, amarga bela Judíoʼsurmaladgi eba-Bab-Dummad-ibmar-imaksadi sognai gusad.

Bela Pablo-itosmargu, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannodmalad, geb Pabloʼga sogdemalad: “Gwenad, be dakena, ibiyobi miliba (1,000) bukidar Judíoʼmar Bab-Jesúsʼgi bengussuli, degite, wemarde amba Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba dabimarbalid.

Emide, Judíoʼmar-Jesúsʼgi-bengussurmalad begi sunmakmalad, Pablo, Judíoʼsurmalad-abargi Judíoʼmar-mamaid-odurdakdiiye, ega sogdiiye: ‘Melle Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba bemar damaloye, abgan-uka-duku-siked-igar mer imakmarbaloye, degine, anmar-dadgan-igar-mamaidba mer damarbaloye.’
Ar dulemar be-wisgudamalogua, bede noniye, ¿igi anmar ega sogoe?

”Degisoggu, anmar-bega-ibmar-sogedba be imako: Anmar-abargi wegi walabake-dulemar-gudiidi, bato Bab-Dummadga sogsamalad: ‘An bega ibmar samaloye.’ Amar degi-sogsamaladi, Bab-Dummadga deyob imakedsegad.

Degisoggu, a-sapingana be sedo, amarbo be na san-swilidik-imaked-igar imako. Degi, sailagia-swiri-imalaga ega be bennukbaloed. Adi, dulemar magar be-dakoed, begi-sunmakmaladi, we gakanye. Degine, magar dakmarbaloed, bede, be Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba nue-nanadimoye.

”Ar Judíoʼsurmalad-Bab-Jesúsʼba-nagusmaladgardi, anmar bato garda narmaksad. Ega anmar sogsad: ‘Ibmar-bab-dummadga-imaklegedga ibmar-uklesmalad mer gunmaloye, degi, mer abe gobmarbaloye, agine, ibmar gammu-gaar-oburgwilesmalad mer gunmarbaloye, degi, mer galagwensuli negsichigi ome-dikarba, degi, sui-dikarba yoledii gumarbaloye.’ ”

Degisoggu, Pablo dulemar-warbakegwad sessunnad, degine, banedgine, amarbo Moisés-Igar-Maidba na san-uruksamarsunnad. A-sorba, Pablo, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogded, adi, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-owisogega, sana na san-burba-uruked-ibagan ega berguoe, adi, a-ibagi, na wala-walagwenad-nuggi Bab-Dummadga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukegar.
Pablo-galesad
Deun, bato san-uruksad-ibagan ibagugle-modanikidgi (7), Judíoʼmar-Asia-yarginmaladi Pablo-dakarmalad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negyaba gudii. Amar bela dulemar-oulusmalad. Geb degi, Pablo-gasmargu,

binnasur gotemalad: “¡Israel-dulemar, an-bendakdamar! We-dule bela-neggweburmar-irba anmar-dulegi isdar-sunmakdiid. Dule-odurdakdiid, mer Moisés-Igar-Maidba be damarye, degine, we-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siidgi isdar-sunmakdibalid. Deginbali, we-dule, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse Griego-dulemar-odosbalid. Ar wede deyob igar maisulid, ar ised. Degisoggu, we-neg-nued-isligwar-siid iwisasad.”
Ar ade, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Pablo-daksagusmalad, Éfesoʼgined-Trófimoʼye-nugadbo gudii. Degidbali, na binsasmalad, Pablo Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse Trófimo-odosye.

Degisoggu, bela-dulemar-neggweburginmaladi oimakarmarsunnad, ber-bulale Pablo-gaega duurmakdemalad. Pablo-gasmargu, ise-ebipiar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi onosmalad. Yog e-iduar yawagak edisa imaksamalad.
Dulemar Pablo-iblogednaga-gunanaidgine, Roma-sorda-dummad-owisosmalad, ega sogsamalad, bela Jerusalén-neggweburgine dulemar urwebukmarye.

Degisoggu, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid e-sordamarse gochad, degi, sordagan-dummaganse gochabalid, geb dulemar-urwebukmaladse bela duurmakarmalad. Dulemar, Roma-sorda-dummad, e-sordamarmala-dani dakarmargu, Pablo-sarsonanaid indaas imaksamalad.
Geb Roma-sorda-dummad dulemarse warmakdapgu, Pablo-gadapid. Geb esgoro-dub-goabogi edinnoye igar uksad. A-sorba, geb dulemarse egichided: “¿We doa-dule? ¿Wede ibu oakalosa?”
Ar dulemar bela goledigibisoggu, Roma-sorda-dummad aku-itosunnad, ar ibiga wede nue urwebukmala, ar ade, bela oimakbukwad. Degisoggu, Roma-sordamar-ambikued-negse Pablo-sesmarsunnad.
Sordamar-ambikued-neg-arsan-mosgu, sordamar gukingi-mai Pablo-sesmalad, ar dulemar ber na barmesnanaid.
Ar ade, dulemar sorba-duurmakdanimalad, binnasur gordanimalad, we-dule oburgwileged bur nabirye.
Pablo na san-bendakega sunmaksad

Roma-sordamar-ambikued-negse Pablo-odosokarmargu, Pablo, sordamar-e-dummadga sogded: —¿Sunna an bega wis ibmar sogsale? Roma-sorda-dummad Pablo-abin sogded: —¿Sunna Griego-gaya be sunmaksi? Wissurye an be-biendo.
Andi Egipto-duleye an be-biendo, ar a-dulede, emisgwasaar neg-oimakdii gusad. A-dule, sordamar-milibake (4,000) nega-dulesulidganba sesa gusad. Andi a-duleye an be-biendo.
Geb Pablo abin-sogded: —Suli. An Judío-duled. Tarso-neggweburgi an gwalulesad. Tarso-neggweburde, Cilicia-yargi nue-nug-nikamogadid, an a-duledo. Wis dulemarga sunmakega be an-imake.
Roma-sorda-dummad Pablo-sunmakega imaksasunnad. Pablo arsangi gwisgusgua, dulemar-boo-imakega argan oyosad. Dulemar bela boo ambikusgua, Hebreo-gayaba amarga sunmakded. Weyob sogded:
